detail: Zero existing Airtable rows for IMPRESSIVE before this run. Every detail on every row is unreconciled against a live record — spec confidence is unearned even though 156 of 220 rows matched an existing live Lightspeed SKU (169 live IMPRESSIVE products observed) and carry that product's real ID/handle verbatim. Cost basis is CONFIRMED (bert-airtable-schema, 2026-09-12): 'Above 3 Skids' bulk tier throughout the volume-tiered vinyl sections, the single printed PRICE where no tier exists (laminate, engineered hardwood, solid hardwood), 'Above 2 Skids' on the page-8 promo section (treated as an ordinary 2-tier cost sheet per that subsection, not a Promo — no separate regular price or expiry printed). The one thing NOT yet confirmed by Albert: the internal SKU/handle prefix, proposed here as 'IMPR' (same 4-letter-supplier-code pattern as HMPR/JLTI) and Airtable Supplier value 'Impressive' (mixed case, following the supplier_aliases convention) — neither has a live precedent to confirm against since Airtable has zero rows for this supplier. 64 rows are new to Lightspeed too: 8.5mm SPC vinyl, both gluedown vinyl lines, the Platinum 7.5"/9" laminate line, the 6" Hickory engineered line, the Engineered Prefinished promo line, and 3 hardwood transition trims (no live LS code for those — sequential ACC-IMPR-0001..0003 minted, unlike the vinyl/laminate trims which reused their real live LS codes IMP.V.*/IMP.LM.*).
